deadline.value: Submit everything before January 1 for full financial-aid consideration (fall). Year inferred.
deadline.quote: In order to receive full consideration for financial aid, applicants should submit all materials (application, transcripts, and letters of recommendation) before January 1 for fall admission

gre_subject.value: Preferred for physics applicants (optional for astronomy); take the October test
gre_subject.quote: The Physics and General GREs are preferred for physics applicants.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by the department's admissions review of the whole application; no faculty agreement is needed before applying.
supervisor.quote: The Physics and Astronomy program reviews all applications and makes recommendations on admissions and support packages.

funding.value: Department generally guarantees PhD support for 5 years
funding.quote: We are generally required to guarantee support to all Ph.D. students for 5 years.

entry_route.value: An undergraduate degree with a GPA of 3.0 or better is normally what is required; a master's degree is not.
entry_route.quote: An undergraduate degree with a cumulative grade-point average of 3.0 or better in undergraduate courses is normally required for admission.

fee_waiver.value: SGS auto-waives for certain groups; department can waive for a few applicants each year, usually used up months before the deadline - ask early
fee_waiver.quote: The department has a small budget that typically allows us to waive fees for a few applicants each year. Normally, all of these funds are used a few months before the application deadline.

gre_general.value: Preferred for physics applicants (optional for astronomy)
gre_general.quote: The Physics and General GREs are preferred for physics applicants.

notes: Final decisions generally before April 15 for complete applications received by January.
